Docs-only link refresh; verified every replacement URL live. Four of five are good: https://ubuntu.com/enterprise-store/docs/ (set-up-air-gapped-maas.md), https://docs.cloud-init.io/ (cloud-init.md), https://canonical.com/maas (tutorial.md), https://canonical.com/multipass (harden-a-maas-test-controller.md) all resolve. The internal swap in deploy-dpus.md:425 is also sound: docs/how-to-guides/manage-machines.md exists ('Manage machines', covers discovery→release, matching the 'How to Manage Machines' anchor text), and root-absolute /how-to-guides/*.md links are the established convention in this tree (e.g. decommission-maas.md:27). One blocker: the iptables replacement in logging.md:16 is a verified HTTP 404 — the old help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo URL now redirects to that same 404, because the Ubuntu wiki was migrated to a new MediaWiki instance and the IptablesHowTo page was not carried over (wiki search finds no Iptables page; wiki banner: 'Legacy content may be unavailable'). So this PR swaps one dead link for another and will fail docs `make linkcheck` (docs/Makefile:108-109 exits 1 on '[broken]'). Also, one same-class broken link remains outside this diff: docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus-without-bmc.md:18 links https://maas.io/docs/how-to-work-with-tags#heading--automatic-tags, which redirects to canonical.com/maas/docs/stable/how-to-guides/work-with-tags/ and 404s (verified) — the exact failure mode this PR fixes for deploy-dpus.md, so consider including it here (the join-our-forum.md maas.io hit is only a Google-Form prefill parameter, not a navigation link, and can be left alone).

docs/reference/configuration-guides/logg.16: This replacement URL is dead: https://wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo returns HTTP 404 (verified). The old https://help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo is also dead now — it redirects to this same 404 after the Ubuntu wiki migration to MediaWiki, and the page was not migrated (searching the new wiki returns no Iptables page). Net effect: the link is still broken and `make linkcheck` (docs/Makefile:108) will report it as [broken] and fail CI. Suggest a verified-working target instead, e.g. https://netfilter.org/documentation/ (upstream netfilter/iptables docs, verified 200) or https://ubuntu.com/server/docs/security-firewall (Ubuntu Server Guide firewall page, which the new wiki's UFW page itself lists as the current Server Guide link; it redirects to the Ubuntu Server firewalls docs).
